blocks.text: Medicines prepared in the pharmaceutical industry are vitally important for human health. Chemistry explains how drugs actually work inside the body. A drug's safety limits and its best dose range are two crucial aspects of medicine: knowing how safe a drug is and how it acts makes sure that it is absorbed safely and acts on the target disease. This part of the chapter discusses these ideas, then looks at agriculture and industry.
